seo.title: Money Kuts Barbers | Skin Fades, Tapers & Gold Masks at Sunset Mall, Jumeirah
seo.description: Money Kuts Barbers, Sunset Mall, Jumeirah 3: skin fades, taper fades, braids, beard trims, hair colour and gold-mask facials. Open daily until 10:30 PM (11:30 PM weekends). 4.7 from 480 reviews.

hero.lede: Skin fades, tapers, braids, beard work and gold-mask facials in a marble-and-gold shop at Sunset Mall. Travellers from Melbourne to Mali say it's the best fade they've had.
hero.image_alt: Money Kuts storefront with gold logo and marble interior

cta_text: Hi Money Kuts, I'd like to book a fade.

items.quote: We've done a lot of travelling over the past 15 years, which means a lot of fades, and this place is out of this world.
